mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO rises > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS declines.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real final sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS rises.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising.
